implemented_capabilities.notes: ~25 named, parameterized Cypher templates executed only through GRAPH.RO_QUERY. Every evidence join requires Evaluation.artifact_hash == Policy.artifact_hash, Evaluation.suite_fingerprint == Suite.fingerprint and complete_suite = true, so stale or mismatched evidence silently drops out. Each QueryResult records template, exact Cypher, params, rows, record ids and the graph revision.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Trusted idempotent graph ingest with global revision counter
implemented_capabilities.notes: MERGE-on-stable-id writers plus a (:Meta {id:'meta'}) revision bumped on each change. Decisions are stamped with graph_revision. rebuild() deletes the graph and replays append-only JSON records, so the graph is a rebuildable projection of durable evidence.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Append-only evidence records with O_EXCL write-once semantics
implemented_capabilities.notes: Every run/evaluation/trial/decision/promotion/decision_outcome is written once with os.O_EXCL and mode 0o444. source_snapshot hashes every ew/*.py and sim/*.py file and shells out to git for commit and dirty state so exports are bound to their source tree.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Decision outcome as a separate post-action node with regression propagation
implemented_capabilities.notes: A DecisionOutcome node links the original Decision, the Run and child/parent Policies via HAS_OUTCOME, ASSESSED, COMPARED_AGAINST and REGRESSED_AGAINST edges. The original pre-action Decision is never mutated. A Cypher template walks DERIVED_FROM*0..8 ancestry and excludes any origin whose ancestors regressed, or whose lineage exceeds the hop cap (unexamined_ancestors). This is a genuine dependency-exclusion cascade.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Rule-based parent selection with explicit rejection reasons
implemented_capabilities.notes: Frozen ranking rules (ew-select-1/2/3) run only on graph read templates. They reject candidates for contract/robot mismatch, non-completed status or failed on-disk artifact hash, return evaluate_candidates when matched validation evidence is missing, and rank by a Beta(1,1)-smoothed success estimate. validate_proposed_origin acts as a guardrail that vetoes an LLM-proposed origin.
Copies the production graph to ew_whatif_<id>, marks interventions hypothetical=true and measured=false, and refuses writes to any other graph name. Decisions from the copy carry mode='what-if'.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Semantic sensor/action contract hash and evaluation completeness check
implemented_capabilities.notes: contract_id is a sha256 over the full semantic description, so same-shape but different-semantics checkpoints get different ids. complete_evaluation recomputes rates from raw episodes and rejects partial or tampered summaries.

implemented_capabilities.capability: MCP tool surface and consent-scoped LLM agent
implemented_capabilities.notes: Read tools annotated READ plus one WRITE tool for bounded training. Per-session capability tokens (secrets.token_hex(32), 600 s TTL) never reach the model. A model that proposes an origin is checked by the guardrail before any training run.

implemented_capabilities.capability: PPO policy training / MuJoCo sim2sim transfer domain
implemented_capabilities.notes: Real stable-baselines3 training and evaluation. This is the robotics domain payload and is not relevant to Kairos beyond serving as the data source behind the evidence graph.

graph_models_and_cypher: Labels: Robot, Contract, Policy, Run, Evaluation, Suite, Family, Competency, Mission, Threshold, Trial, Origin, Decision, DecisionOutcome, Promotion, Failure, Hypothesis, Meta. Edges: USES_CONTRACT, FOR_ROBOT, DERIVED_FROM, PRODUCED, STARTED_FROM, TRAINED_ON, ASSESSED, ON_SUITE, OBSERVED_IN, ABOUT, SUGGESTS, REQUIRES, MEASURED_ON, DRAWS_FROM, EVALUATES, FROM_PARENT, FROM_ORIGIN, TARGETS, VALIDATED_ON, UNDER_CONTRACT, VIA_RUN, CONSIDERED, SELECTED, REJECTED, LAUNCHED, BASED_ON, FOR, USED_EVALUATION, HAS_OUTCOME, FOR_RUN, COMPARED_AGAINST, REGRESSED_AGAINST, CITED_OUTCOME. Notable patterns: variable-length DERIVED_FROM*0..8 ancestry with hop cap and an unexamined-ancestor flag; shortestPath((p)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..8]->(a)); hash-equality joins between Evaluation, Policy and Suite fingerprints; UNWIND $criteria / $origins batches; FOREACH(CASE WHEN ...) conditional edge creation. All reads use GRAPH.RO_QUERY. No APOC or GDS. GRAPH.COPY is used for what-if copies and is available in FalkorDB.
algorithms: Beta(1,1)-smoothed transfer-success estimate p_reach=(reached+1)/(completed+2) with multi-key ranking in ew/select.py:decide and _rank_options_v3
Ancestry walk with hop cap that excludes origins whose DERIVED_FROM ancestors are regressed or unexamined (graph/queries.py:mcp_origins_excluding_regressed)
Nearest passing ancestor via shortestPath over DERIVED_FROM (queries.py:mcp_nearest_passing_ancestor)
Hash and fingerprint equality checks for evidence validity (validation.py:complete_evaluation, ingest.evaluation)
PPO policy training and MuJoCo evaluation (rl.py)
backend_interfaces: MCP server over streamable HTTP mounted at /mcp (about 11 tools, 10 READ and 1 WRITE)
frontend_interfaces: Static vanilla-JS pages in web/: index.html + app.js, live.html + live.js + live-arena.js, evidence.html + evidence.js, guide.html, landing.js
Live Cypher console that replays preset read templates through /api/live/query/{name}
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: LLM tool-calling agent (OpenRouter, Groq or Anthropic) over MCP with a guardrail veto (select.py:validate_proposed_origin) and a deterministic fallback; per-session capability tokens; agent traces persisted as append-only records; DecisionOutcome nodes are cited by later decisions (Decision-[:CITED_OUTCOME]->DecisionOutcome), giving the agent a graph-backed memory of past decision results.
tests_present: 21 pytest files under tests/ with about 140 test functions (test_graph.py 12, test_mcp_agent.py 17, test_judge_agent.py 18, test_env.py 13, test_gate3.py 8 and others). Graph tests require a live FalkorDB. A GitHub Actions workflow runs them. The repo also commits recorded evidence under evidence/, artifacts/records and artifacts/policies, which could not be independently re-verified.
dependency_requirements: httpx2==2.13.1 (unusual package name, verify provenance before installing)
security_findings: ew/rl.py:132,136,242,244 - VecNormalize.load on vecnormalize.pkl and PPO.load on model.zip use pickle-based deserialization; the repo ships committed artifacts/policies/*/vecnormalize.pkl and model.zip, so treat those as untrusted code-execution vectors
ew/agent_sessions.py:75 - subprocess.Popen of [sys.executable,'-m','ew.agent','llm'] with the full os.environ copied; arguments are fixed but the child inherits provider API keys
ew/public_training.py:139 - subprocess.Popen training worker started from an API request (consent and quota gated)
ew/provenance.py:17-18 - subprocess.check_output of git rev-parse and git status with fixed arguments (low risk)
ew/judge_agent.py:304-340 - outbound urllib calls to openrouter.ai and api.groq.com using API keys read from environment (fixed hosts, no secrets in source)

ew/api.py:54-60 - hosted read-only middleware whitelists POST /api/decide, /api/whatif, /api/judge/start, /api/public-training/start and /mcp, so those endpoints stay open to unauthenticated callers in hosted mode
ew/whatif.py:43 - f-string Cypher interpolates a relationship type, but the value is a fixed literal chosen by code, not user input
ew/mcp_client.py:6 - imports the nonstandard module httpx2 (pinned httpx2/httpcore2 in requirements) alongside normal httpx; verify these are legitimate packages
Dockerfile and compose.yaml reference a pulled FalkorDB image; version pinning was not checked
duplicates_or_overlaps: Decision lineage and provenance (Decision -> BASED_ON -> Evaluation, DecisionOutcome, CITED_OUTCOME), stale-evidence rejection via hash joins, ancestor-regression exclusion (a form of dependency invalidation), what-if graph forks. Overlaps with agent-memory/provenance repos and with any cascade-invalidation engine.
evidence_drift_relevance: HIGH - evidence is bound by artifact_hash and suite_fingerprint so changed artifacts invalidate prior evaluations, decisions are stamped with graph_revision and cite exact evidence ids, outcomes are append-only separate nodes, and a regression on an ancestor excludes descendants; it lacks explicit validity intervals and supersession edges.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: Small, self-contained pattern for read-only templated Cypher that returns the exact query, parameters, row ids and graph revision with every answer, combined with hash-equality evidence joins and an ancestor-exclusion cascade. Pair with ew/records.py (O_EXCL write-once records) and ew/whatif.py (GRAPH.COPY what-if forks) for provenance and replay.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB (client 1.8.0 matches Kairos); no OpenAI key needed for the graph and provenance parts; torch and stable-baselines3 only for the robotics payload

strategy_rationale: The robotics RL domain has no value for Kairos, but the hash-bound evidence joins, revision stamping, QueryResult receipts, write-once record store and GRAPH.COPY what-if helper are domain-neutral and can be lifted into a shared evidence/provenance engine. Do not import the torch, SB3 or MuJoCo parts.
